questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

I say a small

A- prayer whenever I ring

B- next assignment

C- the doorbell to my
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **ACB**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Reading the above question we find that: 

 
• The first fixed part ends with an adjective **small**. 
 
• Therefore it should be followed by a **noun**. 
 
• Out of all the given options, only **A **starts with a **noun**. 
 
• In option **1 ABC **we find that it ends with **C **which has a possessive pronoun '**my**' in the end. 
 
• Since a sentence cannot end with a possessive pronoun **option 1 ****ABC **can be eliminated. 
 
• This leaves us with the final option starting with **A **i.e **ACB**. 
 
• Therefore the correct answer is **ACB**.

The correct sentence will be: ***I say a small prayer whenever I ring the doorbell to my next assignment****.*

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'no improvement'.**

We kept aside our clothes, (clean) our hiking boots and made sure we had our thick woollen socks.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Cleaned**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Reading the given sentence we find that: 

 
• The verb **kept **is used in the first part of the sentence. 
 
• Therefore the sentence is in the simple past tense. 
 
• Thus the tense of the other verbs must align with the tense of the sentence. 
 
• For the verb **clean**, its **simple past tense** is **cleaned**. 

Therefore the correct answer is **Cleaned**. 

The correct sentence will be: *We kept aside our clothes, **cleaned** our hiking boots and made sure we had our thick woollen socks. *

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'no improvement'.**

The diesel engines replaced the steam engines and the old ﬁrst class coaches (is replaced) by coupes in a corridor.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Were replaced**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Reading the sentence we find that: 

 
• The verb "**replaced**" shows the sentence is in the simple past tense.
 
• So,** past tense** should be used further as well. Therefore, option 4 is wrong. 
 
• Also, there are two subjects- the steam engines and the old first-class coaches.
 
• That means, plural subject, so according to the **sub-verb agreement,** the plural verb should be used. Thus, option 1 is incorrect.
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice form in the **simple past tense.**
 
• **T**hus, the helping verb "**were**" is used with V3, i.e. **replaced. **So, option 2 i.e. "**were replaced**" is the correct answer.

Therefore the correct answer is **Were replaced**.

questions.question:
The following equation is incorrect. Which two signs should be interchanged to correct the equation?

16 - 2 ÷ 40 + 4 × 18 = 40
questions.solution:
Given equation:

16 - 2 ÷ 40 + 4 × 18 = 40

→ 16 ÷ 2 - 40 + 4 × 18

→ 8 - 40 + 72

→ 80 - 40

→ 40 = R.H.S

Hence, answer is ‘÷ and -’.

questions.question: A zoo has few numbers of penguins and polar bears. The total number of heads of both of them is 60 and the total number of their feet is 160. How many polar bears are there in the zoo?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If all 60 animals were penguins (2 feet), the total number of feet would be 60 × 2 = 120.

The extra feet given in the question = 160 − 120 = 40.

Each polar bear contributes an extra 2 feet (since 4 − 2 = 2).

Number of polar bears = Total extra feet ÷ Extra feet per bear = 40 ÷ 2 = 20.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 polar bears.**

⇒ Total number of heads = 60

⇒ Total number of feet = 160

⇒ Feet per penguin = 2

⇒ Feet per polar bear = 4

**Method 1: Alligation Approach**

⇒ If all animals were penguins, total feet = 60 × 2 = 120.

⇒ If all animals were polar bears, total feet = 60 × 4 = 240.

⇒ The average total feet given is 160.

questions.question: A bullet of mass 10 g is ﬁred with a velocity of 20 m/s from a gun of mass 2 kg. Find the recoil velocity (in m/s) of the gun.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**0.1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The mass of the ejected body and the mass of the recoiling body are related to one another by the law of conservation of momentum which is obtained from **Newton’s laws of motion**.
 
• According to the **law of conservation of momentum**, for every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction. Recoiling velocity is an example of this law. From the law, it can be said that
 
 
• **m₁ v₁ = - m₂ v₂**
 
• m1 and v1 are the mass and velocity of the bullet
 
• m2 and v2 are the mass and velocity of the gun
 
 

 
• Here m₁= 10g = 0.01 kg, v₁ = 20 m/s and m₂ = 2 kg, 

⇒ m₁ v₁ = - m₂ v₂

⇒ 0.01 x 20 = - 2 x v₂

⇒ v₂ = 0.2 / 2 =** 0.1 m/s**

**Note: **Recoil velocity will always be **negative **as the gun will always move in the opposite direction of the fired bullet.

questions.question:

B) In 2018 IPL auctions, Mumbai Indians retained Sunil Narine.

C) Australia won the 2016–17 Women's FIH Hockey World League Final.
questions.solution:
None of these statements are true.

 
• Fan Zhendong was the runner up at the World Table Tennis Championship in 2017
